description: Singular mobile attribution and marketing analytics SDK (artifact com.singular.sdk:singular_sdk on maven.singular.net). The whole public API is the static com.singular.sdk.Singular facade: the fire-and-forget reporting calls (event/revenue/customRevenue/adRevenue/setCustomUserId/...) are stubbed, while the ID/session getters and the callback-based short-link/deep-link entry points are protected. Verified against the real smali in blockcraft5 (com.singular.sdk 12.10.0) and the AAR public API (12.16.1). Note: init/event/revenue/customRevenue/setGlobalProperty return boolean, so the patcher stubs them to return 0/false (their real type); the app treats them as fire-and-forget.

protected_patterns.reason: Returns a Map the app may read back and dereference; null would risk an NPE. Not a data-sending call, so it is left working
Returns the long session id; leave it so any app that reads it keeps a sane value
Privacy-state getter (boolean); reflects the limitDataSharing setting and is left intact
Callback-based: the app awaits a com.singular.sdk.ShortLinkHandler callback with the generated link. Stubbing the void method would leave that callback pending forever, so it is left working
